targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.ford_open_disjoint
targets.header: theorem ford_open_disjoint (x y : ℚ) (hne : x ≠ y) : Disjoint (disk x) (disk y)

targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.ford_boundary_disjoint
targets.header:
theorem ford_boundary_disjoint (x y : ℚ) (hne : x ≠ y)
  (hsep : 2 ≤ |det x y|) : Disjoint (boundary x) (boundary y)

targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.ford_tangent_iff
targets.header: theorem ford_tangent_iff (x y : ℚ) (hne : x ≠ y) : tangent x y ↔ fareyAdj x y

targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.ford_real_axis
targets.header: theorem ford_real_axis (x : ℚ) : boundary x ∩ realAxis = {(x : ℂ)}

targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.kiss_unique
targets.header:
theorem kiss_unique (x y : ℚ) (h : fareyAdj x y) :
  boundary x ∩ boundary y = {kiss x y}

targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.two_squares
targets.header:
theorem two_squares (a c : ℤ) (q s : ℤ) :
  (a*q + c*s)^2 + (a*s - c*q)^2 = (a^2 + c^2)*(q^2 + s^2)

targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.kiss_integer_identity
targets.header:
theorem kiss_integer_identity (x y : ℚ) (h : fareyAdj x y) :
  (kissN x y)^2 + 1 = (x.num^2 + y.num^2) * (kissM x y : ℤ)

targets.name: FVLT.FordGeometryV1.kiss_real_identity
targets.header:
theorem kiss_real_identity (x y : ℚ) (h : fareyAdj x y) :
  (kissN x y : ℝ)^2 + 1 =
    ((x.num : ℝ)^2 + (y.num : ℝ)^2) * (kissM x y : ℝ)
